# LightningRouter

> Fund an AI API key with Bitcoin over Lightning. No email, password or card. BTC converts once to USD credits; inference uses TrustedRouter.

LightningRouter and TrustedRouter are operated by Lore Hex Corp. Your API key is
a secret bearer credential. Never put it in a URL, public post, log or support
message. A new account is created only after a verified payment settles.

## Start here

- [Setup guide](https://lightningrouter.ai/docs.md): funding, authentication, API examples and privacy boundaries.
- [Home](https://lightningrouter.ai/): browser funding and setup for Trusted Cowork, OpenCode, Crush and OMP.
- [Live model catalog](https://lightningrouter.ai/api/models): model IDs, USD pricing, limits and reviewed reasoning controls. GET, no key required.
- [Read-only OpenAPI](https://lightningrouter.ai/openapi.json): this site's catalog and health endpoints, not payment tools or inference.
- [L402 funding](https://lightningrouter.ai/l402.md): optional invoice challenge and payment-proof redemption for USD credits. Requires explicit spending authorization. Separate [funding OpenAPI](https://lightningrouter.ai/funding-openapi.json).
- [Pricing](https://lightningrouter.ai/pricing): token rates and the 10% BTC conversion buffer.
- [Funding health](https://lightningrouter.ai/health): current readiness. HTTP 503 means degraded or unavailable.

## Inference and trust

- API base URL: https://api.trustedrouter.com/v1
- Authentication: Authorization: Bearer <your API key>
- [TrustedRouter API docs](https://trustedrouter.com/docs): applies to LightningRouter keys too.
- [Verify attestation](https://trust.trustedrouter.com): independently verify the inference gateway.
- [Provider policies](https://trustedrouter.com/providers): downstream providers still process inference; their retention and encryption guarantees differ.

## Safety and support

Do not pay an invoice or send paid inference requests without the user's
authorization. Use Bitcoin over Lightning, not an on-chain transfer. The invoice
locks a BTC-to-USD conversion quote; balances are held in USD. Never interpret an
unavailable price or balance as zero. Keep a pending payment tab open and wait for
its final status rather than paying again.

- [Usage](https://lightningrouter.ai/usage): private balance and usage after key authentication.
- [Terms](https://lightningrouter.ai/terms)
- [Privacy](https://lightningrouter.ai/privacy)
- [Public support and bug reports](https://github.com/Lore-Hex/lightning-router/issues): no keys or private payment details.
- Private payment help: support@trustedrouter.com
- Security reports: security@trustedrouter.com
